question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Dwarfed varieties of trees and shrubs in pots
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Bonsai"** refers to **the art of growing dwarfed varieties of trees and shrubs in pots.** (बोनसाई)

 
 
• **Example:** He has a beautiful** bonsai** collection that includes miniature versions of various tree species.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Bonsai**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Bonafide** (सत्य): Genuine or real.

 
 
• **Example:** She presented** bonafide** documents to prove her identity.
 
 
 
• **Orchard** (बाग़): A piece of land planted with fruit trees.
 
 
• **Example:** They have an apple** orchard** in their backyard.
 
 
 
• **Botanical** (वनस्पति संबंधी): Relating to plants or plant biology.
 
 
• **Example:** She is studying** botanical** sciences at the university.
